primary_paper: Kang, Shan, Sun, Xu, Chen, Wang, Yang, Zhang, Zhou, Zhu, Zhang and Ma 2022, Biology of Reproduction 106(6):1112-1125, doi 10.1093/biolre/ioac041, PMID 35191464
species_system: PRIMARY human endometrial stromal cells (HESC) from normal endometrium, decidualised in vitro with 8-Br-cAMP plus MPA; eutopic endometrium of women with ENDOMETRIOSIS (EMs) against fertile controls, by immunohistochemistry; an ICR mouse artificial-decidualisation arm. Unchanged from PIF-007, which is the full-text read this row adjudicates on.
perturbation_used: CAPN7 gain of function (Ad-Flag-CAPN7) and loss of function (si-CAPN7) in primary HESC. NO AKT INHIBITOR, AKT KNOCKDOWN OR KINASE-DEAD ARM ANYWHERE IN THE PAPER.
proximal_measurement: AKT1 phosphorylation at Ser473 by Western blot (an activation-site phosphorylation, i.e. an ACTIVITY-STATE readout, reported beside unchanged total AKT1); FoxO1 phosphorylation at Ser319, Ser256 and Thr24; FoxO1 nuclear exclusion by immunofluorescence; CAPN7, AKT1, p-AKT1 and p-FoxO1 (Ser319) immunostaining scores in EMs versus control endometrium, higher in EMs and 'especially in stromal cells (P < 0.01)', with total AKT1 not different.
functional_measurement: PRL and IGFBP-1 promoter-reporter activity, mRNA and secretion under 8-Br-cAMP plus MPA; mouse uterine horn weight ratio. No adhesion endpoint.
what_is_supported: RE-ADJUDICATION FOR U5b, 2026-09-23, on the read PIF-007 already registered: no new paper. Section 5(0): the state the node names - pathologically EXCESSIVE stromal AKT activity - is positively observed, as higher stromal p-AKT1 (Ser473) with unchanged total AKT1 in endometriosis eutopic endometrium, so the definition is ESTABLISHED IN THAT DISEASE FRAME and is not refuted. Section 5(0b): no committed node represents AKT or PI3K activity in any compartment. Section 5(1): SATISFIED - a primary human source read in full and registered (REF-084/PDF-056), which is what the row's own unblock condition asked for. The first criterion that fails is 5(2), for the reason in what_is_NOT_supported.
what_is_NOT_supported: Section 5(2) as this repository applies it - a determinant of the variable the node names that is VARIED BY ADOC (S_FOXO1's row: MPA and cAMP are agents of COND-FULL-COCKTAIL, 'which is exactly what 5(2) asks for'; E_JAG1_NOTCH3's row: a determinant in the ADOC hormonal protocol). Kang's determinant of excess AKT activity is CAPN7 and the endometriosis state, and NEITHER IS AN AGENT, INPUT OR ARM OF ANY ADOC CONDITION; the ADOC protocol does not vary disease status. Under the owner-ratified 5(2) discriminator that is EXTERNAL, not ADOC_RUNNABLE: no experiment in the current or planned ADOC programme varies CAPN7 or endometriosis status, and measuring p-AKT across the existing arms would measure cocktail-driven AKT activity, not a pathological excess. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED, AND RECORDED FOR ANY LATER EDGE PROMOTION RATHER THAN FOR THIS NODE VERDICT: AKT NECESSITY. Kang never inhibits AKT, so AKT-dependence of the FoxO1 exclusion is inferred from co-occurring phosphorylation at canonical AKT sites, not tested; Labied 2006 (PIF-001) reverses MPA-driven FOXO1 retention with LY294002, which inhibits PI3K and is not AKT-specific. The two are consistent with one route and neither isolates AKT. The mouse arm and the endometriosis contrast do not transfer to a healthy non-pregnant ADOC twin.
